overall_prep_notes: Total prep ~2 hours. Bulk: M3 Multiplication Chart, M4 Array Grid Mat, M6 Fact Triangles, M7 Fraction Strips. Base-ten blocks (M1) and counters (M5) are standard math-kit items. The three character puppets (Tony, Maya, Pixel) print on cardstock for years of reuse.
